job.job_description:
The role involves developing integrations, automation solutions, APIs, AI-enabled workflows, and enterprise-grade applications supporting pharmacovigilance operations and regulatory compliance.

Key responsibilities

Understand the client's Argus system and integrate Indegene solution against the same.
Support case processing workflows, product configurations, reporting rules, and business validations.
Develop custom reports and dashboards supporting pharmacovigilance operations.
Design and develop scalable backend applications using Python.
Build REST APIs using FastAPI.
Develop integrations with safety systems, regulatory platforms, document management systems, and AI services.
Implement microservices and event-driven architectures.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
Build automation workflows for case processing, literature review, signal detection, and regulatory reporting.
Develop integrations with:
Oracle Argus Safety
Safety databases
RIM systems
MLR platforms
Clinical systems
Data lakes and warehouses
Work with SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar databases.

Required skills

Years of relevant experience - around 6-8 years
Experience with Argus configuration and support.
Hands-on experience with:
FastAPI
REST APIs
Microservices architecture
SQL and database design
Docker and Kubernetes
Git and CI/CD pipelines
Experience with cloud platforms - AWS
Knowledge of AI/GenAI-based automation in PV operations.
Database
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQL Server

One crucial request:

I want to connect with tech professionals who are genuinely exploring their next career opportunity.
If you want more detailed information about the opportunity, please let us know.
My phone number is +91 964-298-5139. If you decide to stay in the role.
Please share your resume if you are genuinely interested in the position and are ready to get involved in the hiring process.
Please don't share your profile just to look it over and then stop responding when the interview process starts. Additionally, get ready for the interview; practice; go through the JD which is shared with you.
I am fully aware that priorities are subject to change. A brief message is usually appreciated if your circumstances alter; contact is far preferable to disappearing. If you know someone who would fit this position well, please give my contact details to them who's a suitable fit for this role.
In case you are not looking & want to help the community, share with the one looking for opportunities, tag them, and spread the word. If you're actively looking and this role genuinely matches what you're looking for, I'd be happy to connect. Interested candidates can connect with me or share their resume at afzalpasha.mohammed@wisseninfotech.com.
